title: Landbook
brief: A website design inspiration gallery with a large curated collection of landing pages, e-commerce sites, portfolios, and templates, plus boards for saving references. Useful for browsing real-world site design by category.
details: Land-book is a curated, daily-updated gallery of website design inspiration for creatives — hand-picked landing pages, portfolios, blogs, and ecommerce sites, browsable by category (landing, portfolio, blog, ecommerce), section, mobile, motion, OG images, and headlines, and sortable by most recent, recommended, most liked, or most viewed. Each entry shows the site with like counts and a copy link; some entries are paid Framer templates. A solid reference when you need real-world landing-page patterns rather than generic templates.
